content:
Rita Moura, Chairman of the Board of Directors, and António Aguiar Costa Research, Development and Innovation Director participated in the opening session of the PTBIM congress on November 26 and had the opportunity to present BUILT CoLAB to the BIM community in Portugal.

Taking advantage of the moment when the main players in the BIM area in Portugal met at the same event, the two members of the BUILT CoLAB Team were able to present their objectives and positioning, as well as the projects they are already developing, many of them in BIM.

This 3rd Portuguese Congress of ‘Building Information Modelling’, which took place online from FEUP, was attended by about 150 people who attended the opening of the event with a Round Table conducted by Aguiar Costa, with the presence of Conceição Melo (OARN) Joaquim Poças Martins (OERN) and Rita Moura (PTPC).

It should also be noted that António Aguiar Costa is one of the members of the National Organizing Committee of this event, which will have its next edition in 2022 and will be organized by the University of Minho.
